# AI Artist — Portable Fallback

## Load progressively

- `references/creative-brief.md` — define useful visual constraints.
- `references/iteration.md` — explore/iterate without prompt-noise drift.
- `references/visual-review.md` — inspect generated output before acceptance.

## Workflow

1. Define purpose, audience, subject and deliverable.
2. Gather brand/style constraints already known.
3. Clarify only missing choices that materially affect output.
4. Generate materially different directions when exploration is requested.
5. Inspect composition, anatomy/object integrity, text/logo artifacts and brand fit.
6. Iterate from visible failure/success mechanisms.
7. Deliver the best-fitting asset/direction.

Use the active image-generation capability; do not hard-require a particular provider.
